flavor_text: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

接触技を使う時
相手の守りの効果を無視して
本来の1/4のダメージを与える。
相手の守りの効果以外は発動される。
The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

ノーマルタイプの技がドラゴンタイプになり
威力が1.2倍になる。
Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

天気が　にほんばれ状態でなくても
にほんばれ状態として
技を使うことができる。
When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

技のダメージを受けると
相手をやけど状態にする。

The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.
Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.
